## 2025


<details class="course-spoiler">
<summary class="course-summary">
<div class="summary-text">
<h3>Quantitative Methods for Social Sciences</h3>
<p>**1A Sciences Po - 2025/2026 Winter Semester**. Introduction to quantitative methods in the social sciences and some very basic concepts to handle them.</p>
</div>
<div class="summary-icon">+</div>
</summary>
<div class="course-details-full">

<br>

**Course description:** This course seeks to introduce first-year students to the very principles of quantatives methods and ways to interpret and handle their descriptive tools. At the end, students should be able to understand how to use basic statistical concepts with real-world data. 

🇫🇷 Course given in French, therefore the course's materials are in French.
